annotations.title: Add, change or remove Pinterest catalog products

description: Add, change or remove PRODUCTS in a Pinterest catalog directly — no feed file needed. items: up to 1,000 of {itemId (your SKU), operation UPSERT (default) / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE, attributes {title, description, link, image_link, price e.g. "19.99 USD", availability e.g. "in stock", brand, sale_price, …}}. A create or upsert must carry title, link, image_link and price (refused here otherwise). Pinterest processes the batch asynchronously; the batch is read back and its status and every per-item error reported. 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

adAccountId.description: optional — act as this ad account’s owner via Pinterest Business Access (must be shared with this profile)

catalogId.description: catalog to write to, from list_pinterest_catalogs

items.description: products to add, change or remove; up to 1,000 per call

attributes.description: product fields by name, e.g. title, link, image_link, price: '19.99 USD'

updateMask.description: UPDATE only: attribute names to change; other fields are left as they are

name: update_pinterest_catalog_items
title: Add, change or remove Pinterest catalog products
